notes: ① 面板重排：删掉标题下的一整段导语，改成「标题行 + 一行元信息 + 五格指标条」。标题行 = 配置同步 + 本机徽标 + 云端徽标 + 「重新检测」；元信息行只留 app 版本 / Electron 版本、分支 @ 短 HEAD；指标条五格是 本机/契约、bundle、依赖、备份快照、上次同步，哪一格有问题就转橙或转红，「待办」只在真有事时出现。② 文案精简：卡片里的长解释改成一行 11px 灰字脚注，脚本用法、令牌、备份目录不再堆成正文。③ 修掉三处排版问题：插件更新卡的状态正文原来和按钮挤同一行，英文被压成两段（“no newer version upstr / eam”），现在正文独占一行；键名列加宽到 92px，英文 “Branch / HEAD” 不再折行；脚注不再用 break-all，英文不会在词中间断开。④ 还原备份卡去掉「快照数量」那一行，快照列表从一条一个小框改成细分隔线；生成后的提示压成一行路径 + 一行命令 + 一句脚注。⑤ 同步内容卡每组并成一行（标题 12.5px + 11px 灰字说明），十组一屏看完；展开明细、必需组锁定、只读优先行为不变。⑥ 云端仓库地址未配置从 error 改成 warn：原来左侧红徽标「有问题」和右侧云端「一致」会同时出现，自相矛盾。⑦ 「退出后推送」按钮与「立即拉取（会关闭 DSH）」统一成主按钮样式，一对动作看起来是同一档操作。⑧ README 中英面板截图换成这一版，README.en 的 “What the panel shows” 一节按新布局重写。
notesEn: (1) Panel re-layout: the intro paragraph under the title is gone, replaced by a title row, a one-line meta row and a five-cell metric strip. Title row = Config Sync + local badge + cloud badge + "Re-check"; meta row keeps only app version / Electron version and branch @ short HEAD; the strip shows App/contract, bundle, dependencies, snapshots and last sync, turning orange or red where something is off, and the to-do card appears only when there is something to fix. (2) Copy trimmed: long explanations inside cards became a single 11px grey footnote, so script usage, tokens and backup folders no longer fill the body. (3) Three layout bugs fixed: the plugin-update status text used to share a row with the buttons and got squeezed into two columns in English ("no newer version upstr / eam") — it now owns a full row; the key column is 92px so "Branch / HEAD" no longer wraps; footnotes no longer use break-all, so English words are not split mid-word. (4) Restore-backup card: the "snapshot count" row is gone, snapshots are separated by hairlines instead of boxes, and the post-generation hints collapsed into one path line, one command line and one footnote. (5) Sync-content card: each group is one row (title 12.5px with an 11px grey description right after it), so all ten groups fit one screen; expanding, required-locking and read-only-first all behave as before. (6) An unset cloud remote is a warning now instead of an error: it used to show a red "problem" badge on the left and "in sync" on the right at the same time. (7) The "Push after exit" button now uses the same primary style as "Pull now (closes DSH)", so the pair reads as one class of action. (8) The README panel screenshots (zh and en) are replaced with this version, and the "What the panel shows" section in README.en is rewritten for the new layout.
